About these settings
Quick quality
One tap between Sharp, Balanced and Smooth. These are the Mac\'s settings, so they hold for every device connected to it; with a Mac on the external screen, Ctrl+Alt+Q cycles them
Quality: %1$s
Lower quality automatically on a weak link

When the Mac keeps reporting for 5 seconds that the connection cannot carry the picture, XDesk lowers the quality to the Mac\'s suggestion or one step, and steps back towards your mode after the link has kept up for a while. Only while XDesk is connected to the Mac
Smooth playback
Shows the Mac\'s pictures evenly, by when the Mac captured them. On an uneven network the picture is a little later (at most 50 ms) instead of jumping. Off: each picture as soon as it arrives
Link slowed: quality lowered to %1$s
